data.reason: The ladder requires technical_spec, dev_plan, capability and implementation, and none exists. The technical spec comes first because the others depend on it. It must also settle the two parameters the intent leaves open.
data.wave_reason: Only the technical spec is produced now. The dev_plan, capability and implementation all need the boost duration, the speed multiplier and the touched code parts, and those are fixed in the spec. Agents running together cannot see each other's work, so any of them produced now would guess those values. Stories wait for the dev_plan.

gap.statement: There is no technical design for the post-power-pellet speed boost. The boost duration and the speed multiplier are undecided, and nobody has named where in the existing game they hook in. Until that is written, the plan, contract and code cannot be specified consistently.

premises.text: The intent asks for a brief speed boost after a power pellet but leaves the duration and the amount of speed-up undecided.
The ladder lists technical_spec as required and missing, and the dev_plan, capability and implementation rungs come after it.
No artifact has been produced and the plan is at maturity 0.

artifacts.task: Write intent/g3b/tech-spec.md for the pacman speed boost after a power pellet. Inspect the existing code first to find where pellet eating and pacman movement live. Choose concrete defaults for the duration and the speed multiplier and mark them as tunable constants. State what happens when a second pellet is eaten during a boost (refresh or stack). Describe the state kept, the main flow and how it will be tested.

rejected.why: The duration, the multiplier and the hook points are not fixed, so code written now would guess them and probably be reworked.
The durable contract needs the decided duration and multiplier, which the spec sets.
This is a small brownfield feature and the ladder does not require a brief, so it would not close any required rung.
Four required rungs are still missing and the catalogue can produce them, so no-move would be refused.
